readback.method: visual inspection of all four final PNG files at original resolution
notes: Axes, units or normalization, titles, and legends are visible without clipping.
Force and JVP residual markers remain distinguishable where the two series overlap.
The explicit 1e-18 display floor is identified in the legend; unfloored residuals remain in PLOT_DATA.json.
Native and expected cooling curves overlap by design and are distinguishable by line style; the hostile sign-flip curve is separated.
Normalization residual, density margin, tilt margin, and hostile Gamma-omission residual occupy separable logarithmic bands.
Temperature and entropy-invariant residual use separate aligned panels, avoiding scale or curve overlap.

native_oracle_force_jvp_residual.png.intent: Compare native force and analytic fixed-context state JVP against the frozen current-source JAX oracle over a bounded state-scale sweep with nonsymmetric Sigma and N.
native_oracle_force_jvp_residual.png.units: dimensionless normalized dynamical variables; maximum absolute residual
native_oracle_force_jvp_residual.png.interpretation: The native route agrees with the declared source oracle to floating-point roundoff across the plotted domain. Exact overlap and raw zero residuals are disclosed rather than promoted as exact real-arithmetic equality.
native_oracle_force_jvp_residual.png.claim_effect: SURVIVES_NARROWLY: supports only source-parity for the explicit gamma-law model and sampled certified domain.

log_density_vs_log_mean_scale.png.intent: Check the zero-tilt gamma=4/3 cooling limit using rho/H0^2 = 3 (H/H0)^2 Omega and ell/ell0 = exp(tau), and expose an expansion-term sign mutation.
log_density_vs_log_mean_scale.png.units: log dimensionless ell/ell0 and log dimensionless rho/H0^2
log_density_vs_log_mean_scale.png.interpretation: The native zero-tilt trajectory has the expected local cooling slope. Reversing the +2q expansion term produces a clearly distinct slope and force residual.
log_density_vs_log_mean_scale.png.claim_effect: SURVIVES_NARROWLY: verifies this normalized zero-tilt known limit, not a general background solution or performance claim.

tilt_normalization_and_domain_margin.png.intent: Read finite-boost normalization together with positive density and subluminal-tilt margins along one deterministic native trajectory.
tilt_normalization_and_domain_margin.png.units: dimensionless integration time, invariant residual, and physical-domain margins
tilt_normalization_and_domain_margin.png.interpretation: The sampled trajectory remains inside Omega>=0 and |v|<1 while u^a u_a+1 remains at roundoff. Omitting the Lorentz Gamma normalization produces the nonzero |v|^2 residual shown separately.
tilt_normalization_and_domain_margin.png.claim_effect: SURVIVES_NARROWLY: supports normalization and domain preservation for the bounded trajectory; it does not certify every initial condition.

entropy_temperature_invariant.png.intent: Check the existing exogenous mean-scale temperature relation through g_*s(T) T^3 ell^3 over the declared QCD-transition-spanning regime.
entropy_temperature_invariant.png.units: T in GeV; ell/ell0 and normalized entropy invariant dimensionless
entropy_temperature_invariant.png.interpretation: The residual is consistent with the existing brentq solve in log10(T) using xtol=1e-10. This diagnostic reads the established exogenous temperature utility and does not feed T_gamma into RF-03 force or JVP.
entropy_temperature_invariant.png.claim_effect: NARROWS: coupling remains NONE; no tilted-temperature formula or new thermodynamic authority is inferred.

hostile_mutations.name: expansion_term_sign_flip
hostile_mutations.signal: initial dOmega maximum absolute difference 1.0 and cooling slope -6 instead of -4

hostile_mutations.name: normalization_gamma_omission
hostile_mutations.signal: u^a u_a+1 becomes |v|^2, bounded below by 0.026267878326708485 on the sampled trajectory

surviving_claim: Bounded parity, known-limit, normalization, physical-domain, deterministic-trajectory, and exogenous entropy evidence for explicit_gamma_law_tilted_perfect_fluid_v1 only.
rejected_or_excluded_claims: T_gamma influence on gamma-law force or JVP
